feeds.title: Greenpeace India
feeds.description: Greenpeace India is an independent organization registered in India, connected to a network of other Greenpeace offices in over 55 countries. Their company blog features articles on nature, earth problems, environment issues, natural fuels and more environment related topics and latest news.

feeds.title: Swechha Blog
feeds.description: Swechha is one of the leading environmental NGOs in India. They are an organization dedicated to enabling ourselves and others around us to 'Be the Change', in making a visible difference to the Environment both physically and socially. Their mission is to inspire, create and support a just, equitable, and sustainable society, for everyone and forever. The Swechha Blog features articles on the NGO's activities, social events, problems, society issues, the latest new sand updates.

feeds.title: Search for Water!
feeds.description: EFI is the Environmentalist Foundation of India, a voluntary organization focusing on result-oriented-real-time environment conservation projects. The group is active in Chennai, Hyderabad, Coimbatore, Delhi, and Trivandrum with smaller projects in Shillong and Srinagar. EFI is open to all those who wish to volunteer for India & its environment. Head straight to their blog to learn more about the foundation, their work, ongoing projects, and more useful information.

feeds.title: Give's Blog » Environment
feeds.description: Give exists to alleviate poverty by enabling the world to give. Established in 2000, Give, together with its partners, is the largest and most trusted giving platform in India. Give enables individuals and organizations to raise and donate funds conveniently to any cause they care about, with offerings including crowdfunding, corporate giving, cause marketing, and philanthropy consulting. Head to their environmental blog and read about climate change, nature-related problems, NGOs, social issues, and more similar subjects.

feeds.title: Down To Earth
feeds.description: Down To Earth Blog covers News on the environment including global warming, climate change, air pollution, solar energy, wind energy, El Nino effect noise pollution and energy we use in our everyday lives. Read latest environmental news headlines from India and across the world.

feeds.title: Delhi Greens Blog
feeds.description: The Delhi Greens Blog has been in publication since 2007 and remains at the forefront of the Indian and the global environmental movement. We publish environmental articles and essays and disseminate information for environmental protection and biodiversity conservation. The Delhi Greens Blog is the flagship project of the Delhi Greens non-profit organisation.

feeds.title: Mongabay India
feeds.description: Mongabay seeks to raise interest in and appreciation of wild lands and wildlife, while examining the impact of emerging trends in climate, technology, economics,and finance on conservation and development. Mongabay-India is an environment and conservation platform that brings high-quality, original reports from nature's frontline in India through its blog. They look at India's development through the prism of environment and conservation.

feeds.title: Sigma Earth
feeds.description: Sigma Earth is your one-stop sustainability platform dedicated to creating a greener and more sustainable future. They offer a comprehensive range of services, including environmental courses, green job listings, and sustainability events, aimed at empowering individuals and organizations to positively impact the environment.

feeds.title: WRI India Blog
feeds.description: WRI India is an independent non-profit research organization that works to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development. WRI India's mission is to go beyond research to put ideas into action, and work with governments, business, and civil society to build transformative solutions that protect the earth and improve people's lives in India. To know more about the organization, their work, ongoing projects, environment issues and social community problems follow their blog.
